title: ephemerantha labangensis
intro: Ephemerantha labangensis, commonly known as the Philippine orchid, is a species of flowering plant in the orchid family. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, particularly in traditional Filipino medicine. The health benefits of Ephemerantha labangensis include its ability to reduce inflammation, improve wound healing, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its therapeutic actions such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial effects.
